description: Main package for import restriction enforcement in a Kubernetes-related project, handling package loading, import analysis, and rule verification.

classes.name: ImportBoss
classes.description: Handles import restriction verification, including direct and transitive import analysis, and inverse rule verification.

classes.name: FileFormat
classes.description: Represents import restriction rules loaded from YAML files, including normal and inverse rules.

classes.name: Rule
classes.description: Defines a single import restriction rule with regex selector, allowed and forbidden prefixes, and transitive flag.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Entry point for the import restriction enforcement program, initializes flags, loads packages, verifies rules, and handles errors.

methods.name: loadPkgs
methods.description: Loads Go packages based on provided patterns with specific configuration, handling errors.

methods.name: massage
methods.description: Processes loaded packages to filter out test packages and rename test packages.

methods.name: unmassage
methods.description: Removes test package suffixes from package path strings.

methods.name: newBoss
methods.description: Creates an ImportBoss instance, initializing import maps and computing transitive closures.

methods.name: hasTestFiles
methods.description: Checks if a package has test files.

methods.name: Verify
methods.description: Verifies import rules for a package, including direct and inverse rules.

methods.name: packageDir
methods.description: Determines the directory of a package based on its source files.

methods.name: verifyRules
methods.description: Verifies import rules for a package against loaded restriction rules.

methods.name: verifyInverseRules
methods.description: Verifies that all packages importing a package are allowed to do so, based on inverse rules.

methods.name: recursiveRead
methods.description: Recursively reads import restriction YAML files up to the module root.

methods.name: readFile
methods.description: Reads and unmarshals a YAML restriction file into a FileFormat object.

methods.name: isGoModRoot
methods.description: Checks if a directory is the root of a Go module by presence of go.mod.

methods.name: removeLastDir
methods.description: Removes the last directory component from a path.

methods.name: transitiveImports
methods.description: Computes direct and transitive import dependencies of a package.

methods.name: dfsImports
methods.description: Performs depth-first search to gather transitive imports.

methods.name: transitiveClosure
methods.description: Computes the transitive closure of import dependencies using Warshall's algorithm.
